2. Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR): PCR is a technique used to amplify specific regions of the DNA, making it easier to analyze. 3. Sequencing: Once the DNA has been extracted and amplified, it can be sequenced to determine the order of the nucleotides (A, T, C, and G) that make up the genetic code.
